authority: Office of Development Commissioner (Handicrafts), Ministry of Textiles
interpretation: This packet records current first-party observations for reviewer use. It does not establish a universal grant, guaranteed event selection, participant admission, reimbursement, stipend or open deadline.
sourcePolicy: The NHDP guideline controls the component descriptions and broad route. The current DC (Handicrafts) schemes and circular indexes control current FY 2026-27 notice presence. The attached notice PDFs, current MIS route and component-specific terms must be reviewed before publication.

supportingSources.anchor: NHDP is listed under the generic schemes implemented by the Office of Development Commissioner (Handicrafts); the scheme is composite and not specific to area, caste or gender.
Current circular index lists FY 2026-27 MSS proposal and domestic/Dilli Haat marketing-calendar notices.
Current official news index repeats the FY 2026-27 MSS calendar and proposal notices.

records.sourceAnchor: NHDP guideline index and Marketing Support and Services component; current FY 2026-27 MSS notices in the official circular index
observations: The NHDP guideline describes Marketing Support and Services as a programme component for market-access and marketing activities rather than an automatic cash benefit for every artisan or business.
The official circular index currently lists an invitation for MSS project proposals during FY 2026-27 dated 2026-01-02.
The same index lists an international marketing action-plan notice dated 2026-01-19, a domestic marketing-events calendar dated 2026-03-31 and a Dilli Haat marketing-events calendar dated 2026-04-06.

The current index proves that the notices exist, but the attached PDFs must be checked for eligible agency class, event-level deadline, proposal format, contribution/stall terms, selection and reporting conditions.
The route is agency/project and event based. UdyamVeda must not show a fixed rupee entitlement, guaranteed stall, guaranteed sales or automatic selection.
reviewFollowUps: Open and hash the current FY 2026-27 MSS proposal notice and both marketing-calendar PDFs.
Confirm eligible government bodies, corporations, NGOs, cooperatives, producer companies or other agency classes and the exact MIS submission route.
Extract event-level deadlines, participant capacity, stall/contribution terms, assistance limits, selection authority, reimbursement rules, reporting and cancellation conditions.
Check amendments, corrigenda and whether each listed event or proposal window is still actionable on the date of recommendation.
Keep market-access value separate from any subsidy, reimbursement or other financial support.

supportingSources.anchor: NHDP scheme index and Design and Skill Development in Handicraft Sector component.
Current circular index lists Invitation of Project Proposal under Skill Development for Handicraft Sector for FY 2026-27 dated 02 January 2026.
Current official news index lists the FY 2026-27 SDHS project-proposal notice.

records.sourceAnchor: NHDP guideline Design and Skill Development component, including design and technology workshops, toolkit distribution, Guru Shishya training and comprehensive skill upgradation; current FY 2026-27 SDHS notice
observations: The NHDP guideline identifies Design and Skill Development in Handicraft Sector as a component with design and technology development workshops, toolkit distribution, Guru Shishya Hastshilp Prashikshan and comprehensive skill upgradation.
The official circular index currently lists an Invitation of Project Proposal under Skill Development for Handicraft Sector for FY 2026-27 dated 2026-01-02.
The earlier CSUP material in the seed is retained only as historical component detail; it must not be treated as the current FY 2026-27 participant notice.
Component-specific participant, craft, PAHCHAN, batch, trainer, duration, attendance, toolkit, certificate and agency conditions must be taken from the current notice and approved programme route.
This is training/design support, not a guaranteed grant, job, loan, stipend or market order.
reviewFollowUps: Open and hash the current FY 2026-27 SDHS proposal notice and identify the official MIS/application route.
Confirm whether the current notice is for implementing agencies, individual participants, or both, and capture component-specific eligibility.
Verify PAHCHAN, craft identity, batch size, duration, trainer/agency approval, toolkit/stipend/certificate, attendance, monitoring and reporting terms.
Record the exact deadline or mark the route notice-listed but deadline-unverified until the attachment is reviewed.
Keep historical CSUP details separate from current FY 2026-27 terms.

publicationGuard.reason: The official scheme and circular indexes establish current notice presence, but the attached FY 2026-27 notices, exact terms, deadline status and current application route still require source capture and human review.
